design_choices.pess2_demotion: k late-resolved usual starters in a team-game demote the k box-score starters with the fewest prior starts this season (the player's starts in earlier games of the same season, any team), ties lowest player_id
design_choices.shuffle: starter flags permuted among ALL box rows of each (game, team) (keeps the count), one draw per team-game from default_rng(0) in (game_id, team_id) order
design_choices.bench_tonight_N4: bench tonight = the flag the arm is served (headline t30_starter for RT/RT_SH, pess2 flag for RT_P2/RT_P2S); the headline-flag bench row is also printed
design_choices.range_low_end: the rule's [min(pess2, P2S), headline]: the low end is read as the WEAKER worst case (the gain smaller in magnitude, i.e. the numerically larger of the two); the literal numerical min is printed beside it
design_choices.l60_power: P(point <= -0.005 and 98.18% CI upper < 0) = Phi((min(-0.005, -2.36 SE) - effect) / SE), SE = date-clustered 2024 SE x sqrt(D / 60) / sqrt(0.85); FORWARD's Phi(|effect|/SE - 2.36) printed beside it
design_choices.slices: N1/N2 slices use the headline flags (status changed, starter / bench tonight); late-resolved team-games from the gate definition

N2.pts: the starting five adds beyond recent role; recommend a T30-on-FULL (or AVG) shadow arm under a new rule id
N2.reb: the starting five adds beyond recent role; recommend a T30-on-FULL (or AVG) shadow arm under a new rule id
N2.ast: conditional; the live T30 shadow decides
N2.fg3m: the offline T-30 gain over FULL is below the floor; recommend no T30-on-FULL arm (the T30 shadow keeps running for timing)

starter_shuffle.note: single seed, reported not judged (null sd unmeasured)

gate.test: check 1 frame identity: props A0 x 81 columns and P(play) R keys + t30_* equal the frozen pins (full R-frame hash recorded)

raw_unrounded.note: diagnosis only; varies run to run (Amendment 1)

gate.test: L5: pess2 / shuffled t30_* attach to every A0 and R row; no added DNP row enters a scored set (key hashes checked per arm in score)
check 1 reproduction: P0C == stored components, FULL refit == cache (4 stats); FULL pi == pi_R.npz; R refit == stored p_R (or data drift: all refit, reported)
plant: edit every game after the cutoff + a fake future game; t30_* of rows on/before the cutoff bit-identical (t30_vac_starter_min rounded to 1e-9, Amendment 1)
control: flipping the cutoff day's starter flags changes that day's t30_starter
check 5 (flag, not a stop): missingness of t30_* by realised-minutes bucket (pp)
gate.threshold: reported; over the limit = a flag beside every number

gate.test: late-resolved absences per season (reported; frozen gate 572 / 536 / 564)
